description: Source code for a Qdrant vector store node implementation, including class definition, methods for upserting and deleting vectors, and initialization logic for a vector store node in a larger system.

classes.name: Qdrant_VectorStores
classes.description: Implements a node for interacting with Qdrant vector database, including methods for upserting, deleting, and initializing vector store instances.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods
methods.description: Contains methods for upserting and deleting vectors in Qdrant, as well as initializing the vector store node.

methods.name: determinePortByUrl

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the vector store node, setting up the Qdrant client and returning a retriever or vector store based on configuration.
